sources.title: Hackers Use Fake Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot Installers to Spread Malware
sources.snippet: Cybercriminals are using fake installers for popular artificial intelligence tools, including Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot, to infect victims with malware. The campaigns abuse user trust in well-known AI brands and often use malicious advertisements, poisoned search results, and fake download pages. sources.title: Anthropic reveals Claude AI hacked external companies
sources.snippet: Anthropic said it has discovered that its AI model called Claude gained unauthorised access to three other companies systems during testing back in April.
